subject: CareVector: AuthZ snapshot, SAML assertions, and SCIM reconciliation workplan
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@carevector.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@carevector.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: AuthZ snapshot request + sample SAML assertions

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked us to get a short intake together for the security review — specifically they want a snapshot of role mappings, example SAML assertions from a couple of sign-in events, and a SCIM delta for the last 30 days so our auditors can validate provisioning.

Can Redwood provide: 
- A role-to-permission matrix for the CareVector tenant (CSV or XLSX)
- 3 anonymized SAML assertion samples (with attributes intact but user identifiers hashed)
- SCIM delta export for 2026-01-10 through 2026-02-10

Timeline: procurement wants artifacts by Feb 19 to keep the contract on track. Let us know if that’s doable.

Appreciate it,
Alex

--
Alex Turner
Head of IT Security, CareVector
alex.turner@carevector.com

From: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@carevector.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AuthZ snapshot request + sample SAML assertions

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can deliver.

Quick plan (high level):
1) Role matrix: Jordan will export the current tenant role map and redact personal emails; deliverable: authz_role_map_v1.xlsx.
2) SAML assertions: we can pull assertion logs for three sign-in events and hash subject identifiers. Irene will validate redaction.
3) SCIM delta: we’ll produce a CSV of SCIM provisioning events for the date window you specified.

Question: do auditors require original AssertionConsumerService URLs, or is a redacted hostname acceptable? Also, do you want examples from both a web and API login (we can include one of each)?

We’ll aim for Feb 18 EOD delivery to give a day buffer.

Regards,
Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Senior Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@carevector.com>, Maya Singh <maya@carevector.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AuthZ snapshot request + sample SAML assertions

On Wed, Feb 11, 2026 at 11:20 AM priya_natarajan@redwood.com wrote:
> Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can deliver.

Thanks — quick implementation notes so we’re aligned on redaction and scope: 
- Hashing strategy: SHA256 + per-tenant salt (we’ll include the salt artifact in the delivery notes so auditor can verify hashing if needed).
- Assertions: we will remove IP addresses and replace NameID with a stable hashed id, but keep attributes (email_verified, groups, entitlements) intact. We will keep ACS endpoints but will replace subdomains with "redacted.company" unless CareVector specifically needs originals.
- SCIM delta: include event type (create/modify/delete), timestamp, source of truth (SCIM connector id), and any role changes. We will not include raw passwords or secrets (obviously).

Action owners and ETA: 
- Jordan: run role export & produce authz_role_map_v1.xlsx (ETA Feb 16)
- Irene: extract SAML assertions and run redaction, produce carevector_saml_samples_202601.zip (ETA Feb 17)
- Mina: generate SCIM delta CSV (ETA Feb 17)
- Priya: compile delivery notes and evidence checklist, upload to shared Drive (ETA Feb 18)

I’ll start the extraction today and will post interim notes to the Drive folder.

Irene

--
Irene Choi
Manager, Applied Security & Evidence, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@carevector.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@carevector.com>, Procure Team <procure@carevector.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AuthZ snapshot request + sample SAML assertions

Priya / team — thanks for the update and thanks to everyone for moving quickly. A couple of final asks from procurement & audit before you drop artifacts: 
- Can you include a short CSV mapping role IDs to least-privilege justification (one line per role)? This speeds our audit.
- Please confirm the SCIM delta includes the "externalId" field for downstream reconciliation.
- For the SAML artifacts, we’ll need one assertion where the user is in an admin group and one where they are in an end-user group.

If you can attach the checklist and artifacts to the Drive link and ping procurement when completed, we’ll mark the evidence as received.

Thanks — Alex

--
Alex Turner
Head of IT Security, CareVector
alex.turner@carevector.com

Attachments referenced:
- authz_role_map_v1.xlsx (attached)
- scim-delta-snapshot-20260210.csv (attached)
